Jabalpur Outer Ring Road | Package-03 Detailed Ground Update
In this video, we explore the latest construction progress of Package-03 of the 114 KM Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Project, one of the largest highway infrastructure projects in Madhya Pradesh.
Package-03 is the longest section of the project, stretching nearly 36 KM from NH-45 to Kushner. This package is being developed by ISC Projects Private Limited under the EPC Mode as part of the Bharatmala Pariyojana.
During this ground report, we cover:
NH-45 Flyover Update
Rail Over Bridge (ROB) Progress
Vehicular Underpasses (VUPs)
